theme: Yesterday measured how agents get in and how they stay in the box. Today is the runtime under the loop: Effect UI is a frontend an agent can migrate in one shot, Thorsten Ball says three-month-old agent habits are theater, Matt Van Horn timed 16 Mac computer-use tools, Psychoscript pauses the script an agent wrote, Ramp/Baseten pass KV cache between seven models, Switzerland confirms agentic attacks on critical infrastructure, Ajzenstadt writes the six layers around the model, Tencent DFly2 speeds sparse-model agent decode, Anthropic agents rewrote the live Messages API in Rust, and Robbyant open-sources a navigation agent that remembers a room.
